description: The agent must: (1) Parse the messy requirements file to extract annual outpatient=1200万, inpatient=45万, and 10 AI scenarios with CUSTOM coverage rates (导医导诊=25% NOT 30%, 报告解读-专用=8% NOT 5%). (2) Apply the proprietary formula chain: daily volumes = annual×10000÷365, per-scenario hours = daily_calls × coverage × seconds_per_call ÷ 3600, summing all 10 scenarios. (3) Use the 910B3-specific parameter: 80 hours/card/day (10 concurrent lanes × 8 hours). (4) Compute total cards = total_hours÷80, then ceiling; machines = ceiling(cards÷8); total compute = machines×2.5P. (5) Output a properly structured report in gpu_assessment_report.txt with multi-level section numbering (e.g. 1.1.1), NO markdown tables, listing each scenario with coverage rate, daily calls, and occupation time, followed by total hours summation, then card/machine/compute calculations.
